name: Google Ads
description: Query Google Ads campaigns, performance metrics, ad groups, and customer accounts using GAQL through the Google Ads MCP server.

inputs.label: Google Application Default Credentials (ADC) Path
inputs.description: Path to your application_default_credentials.json generated with gcloud using the adwords scope.

obtain.instructions:
1. Create an OAuth 2.0 Client ID (Desktop app) in Google Cloud Console and download the JSON.
2. Run: gcloud auth application-default login --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform --client-id-file=PATH_TO_CLIENT_JSON
3. Provide the generated credentials path (%APPDATA%\gcloud\application_default_credentials.json on Windows, or ~/.config/gcloud/application_default_credentials.json on macOS/Linux).

inputs.label: Google Cloud Project ID
inputs.description: The Google Cloud Project ID with the Google Ads API enabled.

inputs.label: Google Ads Developer Token
inputs.description: Your Google Ads API developer token (at least Explorer access is required to query production accounts).

obtain.instructions:
1. Sign in to your Google Ads manager account.
2. Navigate to Tools and Settings > API Center.
3. Copy your Developer Token or request access.

inputs.label: Login Customer ID (MCC)
inputs.description: Optional: If accessing customer accounts through a manager account (MCC), specify the numeric 10-digit manager customer ID (without hyphens).

auth.instructions: Requires Google Cloud Application Default Credentials (ADC) with the adwords scope, and a Google Ads API Developer Token. Generate ADC via 'gcloud auth application-default login --scopes=https://www.googleapis.com/auth/adwords,https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform --client-id-file=...'.
